S85.01.needs: a Free or paid account; an image file to upload; a mailbox that can receive the email change code
S85.01.note: The Expected line asks for name, photo and email on one surface; in the code the email is changed on the Account page, not on General.
steps: Open the account menu at the bottom of the sidebar and click Settings.
In General, under Profile, click the Full name field and change the name.
Click Upload photo (or Change photo) and choose a PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or HEIC image.
Click Save profile and wait for Saved.
Reload the page and check the name and photo are still there.
For email: open Settings > Account, click the Email row, then Change email address, and follow the code steps. Check the new address shows on the Account page.
S85.01.where: Account menu (your name at the bottom of the sidebar) > Settings > General > Profile. Email: Settings > Account > Email > Change email address

S85.02.note: The page shows an on/off state (Off. Your instructions are kept and not sent to the model.); the exact on/off control was not traced, and the code does not say per surface (the Expected says per surface).
steps: Open Settings from the account menu and click Personalization.
Scroll to the Instructions for AGI box and type an instruction, for example a reply language.
Wait for the save status to show Saved, then reload the page to confirm the text stayed.
Start a new chat, send a question, and compare the reply with the instruction.
Go back, switch the instructions off, ask again, and compare the reply.
Open Settings from the account menu and click Personalization.
Under Style and tone, change Response style (for example to Concise).
Change Response length or Preferred formatting if you want.
Start a new chat and send the same question.
Compare the reply length, tone and formatting with the choice you made.

S85.04.note: The custom style lives in the composer, not in Settings.
steps: Open a new chat and click Style in the composer footer.
Click Create Custom Style.
Type a name, and in Writing sample paste a sample of your own writing; the instruction box fills automatically if left empty.
Click Save.
Select the new custom style, send a question, and compare the reply with your sample's tone and sentence structure.
S85.04.where: Chat composer (under the message box) > Style > Create Custom Style

S85.05.needs: a Free or paid account; memory is off by default
S85.05.note: The Cloud memory editor shows Cloud memory is unavailable until your account and workspace are ready when the account is not set up.
steps: Open Settings from the account menu and click Personalization.
Find the Persistent memory switch and turn it on.
Add a fact in the Add a new fact field (placeholder starts with Example:) and save it.
Check the fact appears in the memory list; then use Edit memory or Delete memory on it to change or remove it.
Turn the Persistent memory switch off and check the list and the behaviour in a new chat.

S85.06.needs: a Free or paid account with at least one earlier chat on a known topic
steps: Open Settings from the account menu and click Personalization.
Turn on the Search past chats switch.
Start a new chat (not temporary) and ask about a topic from an earlier chat.
Check whether the reply refers to the earlier chat.
Turn Search past chats off, ask again in a new chat, and compare; then start a temporary chat and check it does not refer to other chats.

labels.text: Use memories from outside this project

S85.07.needs: a project and some saved memories on the account
S85.07.note: The Project settings menu item is shown conditionally on the project page; the Save button label in the dialog was not traced.
steps: Click Projects in the sidebar and open a project.
Click Project options at the top of the project.
Click Project settings.
Under Memory, tick or untick Use memories from outside this project and read the line under it.
Save the dialog, then ask a question in a chat in that project and compare with the choice.
S85.07.where: Projects > open a project > Project options (the ... button) > Project settings > Memory

S85.11.note: Searched the settings sections and components for chat history, keep, save and history wording; no control that chooses whether chats are kept in history and synced was found. The nearest controls are Start new chats as temporary (S85.16) and the composer temporary-chat option, which is not the same choice.

S85.12.note: Owner decision is open. The heading text comes from a product-name constant, so the exact visible words were not confirmed.
steps: Open Settings from the account menu and click Privacy.
Scroll to the heading that starts with Help improve and ends with models, and read the note under it.
Turn Use my chats on, then off, and read the description under it.
Turn Use my voice on or off if you want, then reload the page.
Compare the switch states after reload with what you set; the note says both are off and nothing is used for this today.
S85.12.where: Settings > Privacy > Help improve models (heading) > Use my chats

S85.14.note: The code shows a pending opt-out message (Telemetry is off on this browser...); whether reports are actually sent or stopped cannot be seen from the screen.
steps: Open Settings from the account menu and click Privacy.
Find the Share crash and error reports switch and turn it off.
Reload the page and check the switch stays off.
Turn it on again and reload; check the switch shows on.
Compare the switch with its description: error reports, with sensitive fields removed.
S85.14.where: Settings > Privacy > Share crash and error reports

S85.16.note: The switch only changes the default for new chats; existing chats keep their state, and the composer can change it per chat.
steps: Open Settings from the account menu and click Privacy.
Turn on Start new chats as temporary.
Close Settings, click New chat and send a message.
Check the chat is not listed in the sidebar history or in search after you leave it.
Turn the switch off, start a new chat and check it is saved normally.
S85.16.where: Settings > Privacy > Start new chats as temporary

S85.17.needs: a test account with a disposable archived chat
steps: Archive one test chat from the sidebar.
Open Settings > Privacy and click Manage next to Archived chats.
Find the test chat in the list and click Restore; check it returns to the sidebar.
Archive it again, click Delete, confirm Delete chat, and check it moves to Recently deleted.
Compare the list with the copy: restored chats return to the sidebar, deleted ones stay in Recently deleted for 30 days.

labels.text: Delete all chats in this workspace

S85.18.needs: a disposable test account only; this deletes every chat
S85.18.note: The copy says in this workspace, while the Expected says every chat in the user's history; check whether a personal account sees the same scope.
steps: Open Settings from the account menu and click Privacy.
Find Delete all chats in this workspace and click Delete all.
Read the dialog title and copy, which say whether chats can be restored from Recently deleted within 30 days.
Click Cancel unless you are on a disposable test account.
If you confirm on a test account, check the sidebar and the archived list are empty afterwards.
S85.18.where: Settings > Privacy > Delete all chats in this workspace > Delete all

S85.19.needs: a test chat that has a shared link
S85.19.note: Published pages are listed on the same screen (PublishedArtifactsSection is rendered inside SharedLinksSection).
steps: Open Settings from the account menu and click Privacy.
Click Manage next to Shared links.
Find a test shared link and click Revoke.
Read the dialog Revoke this public link? and click Revoke link.
Check the link is gone from the list and that the shared page no longer opens.

S85.20.needs: none; the export can take a while
S85.20.note: Memories can also be exported from Settings > Personalization > Memory > Export memories.
steps: Open Settings from the account menu and click Privacy.
Find Export data and click it.
Wait while the status shows Preparing, then click Download your export.
Open the downloaded file.
Check it contains chats, memory, files and settings as described in Expected.

labels.text: Import memory from other AI providers

S85.22.needs: a memory export file or pasted text from another assistant
steps: Open Settings from the account menu and click Personalization.
Scroll to Import memory from other AI providers and click Start import.
Choose a source (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot or Other), then choose Paste memories or Upload file and add the export.
Click Import to add the selected memories.
Check the message Imported N memories from the source and find the new entries in the memory list.
S85.22.where: Settings > Personalization > Memory > Import memory from other AI providers > Start import

S85.26.note: The code schedules deletion and offers Cancel deletion; it does not delete at once. Expected says the account is deleted after confirmation.
steps: Open Settings from the account menu and click Account.
Click Delete account and read the dialog Delete your account?.
Type DELETE in the confirmation box.
Click Schedule deletion only on a disposable test account.
Check the Account deletion scheduled row and use Cancel deletion to undo it.
